components.name: Key
components.description: Default printed key: square, 2px ink outline, fills solid on hover.

components.name: Quiet Key
components.description: Hairline-outlined key for a deliberate, secondary action such as Neue Warteschlange.
components.css: .ds-key-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:10px 18px;border:2px solid var(--hair,#c9cbcd);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--fg,#111);font-family:"Archivo Variable", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-stretch:92%;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 180ms}.ds-key-quiet:hover{background:var(--fg,#111);color:var(--bg,#f3f3f1)}.ds-key-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1f3bd0);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Poster Transport
components.description: Signature: the poster's ink field with the solid main key and three outlined 52px keys; the second variant shows the overprint (requested) state.
components.css: .ds-poster{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:20px 16px;background-color:#c8380e;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(to right,rgb(255 255 255/.13) 0 1px,transparent 1px 25%);color:#fff;font-family:"Archivo Variable", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-transport{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) repeat(3,52px);gap:8px}.ds-main{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:64px;padding:10px 16px;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:0;background:#fff;color:#c8380e;font:inherit;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:800;font-stretch:85%;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-main:hover:not(:disabled){background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 92%,#c8380e)}.ds-main:disabled{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-style:dashed;font-size:.98rem;cursor:default}.ds-ikey{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:52px;min-height:64px;padding:0;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}.ds-ikey:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgb(255 255 255/.16)}.ds-ikey:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.ds-main:focus-visible,.ds-ikey:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Command Signal
components.description: Signature: requested, accepted, confirmed. Solid only when reached; waiting steps print dashed.
components.html:
Pause angenommen …

  1. Angefordert
  2. Angenommen
  3. Bestätigt
components.css: .ds-sigwrap{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:16px;background:#1f3bd0;color:#fff;font-family:"Archivo Variable", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-sigstat{margin:0;font-weight:700;font-stretch:90%;font-size:.95rem}.ds-signal{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px}.ds-signal li{padding-top:8px;border-top:6px solid rgb(255 255 255/.26);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:650;font-stretch:90%;color:#dfe4ff;transition:border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-signal li.on{border-top-color:#fff;color:#fff}.ds-signal li.wait{border-top-style:dashed}

components.name: Progress Rule
components.description: Thick printed progress rule; solid for the observed position, hatched while held or estimated.
components.html:
1:37 gespeichert3:40
0:44 · Bestätigung ausstehend3:40

components.name: Station Tile
components.description: A Sender on the poster wall: flat ink, name, meta, round figure; selected adds an 8px top bar.
components.html:
Mix & Regeln
Mix & Regeln
components.css: .ds-wall{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:8px;font-family:"Archivo Variable", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-tile{display:grid;background:#c8380e;color:#fff;border-top:8px solid transparent}.ds-tile--sel{border-top-color:#fff}.ds-tile--petrol{background:#00657a}.ds-tile button{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;gap:6px 10px;min-height:112px;padding:14px 14px 10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-tile button:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255/.1)}.ds-tile button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}.ds-tname{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:800;font-stretch:80%;line-height:1.05}.ds-tmeta{grid-column:1;align-self:end;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:550;color:#fff0ea}.ds-fig{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 2;fill:none;stroke:currentColor}.ds-tile a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-top:1.5px solid rgb(255 255 255/.45);color:inherit;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}.ds-tile a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

components.name: Device Select
components.description: Square field with a 2px ink outline and drawn chevron.

components.name: Segmented Positions
components.description: Entdecken ↔ Vertraut as three printed positions over native radios.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--fg,#111);border:2px solid var(--fg,#111);font-family:"Archivo Variable", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-seg label{position:relative;display:flex;flex:1 1 84px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:52px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg,#f3f3f1);color:var(--fg,#111);font-weight:700;font-stretch:90%;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 180ms}.ds-seg input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-seg label:has(input:checked){background:var(--fg,#111);color:var(--bg,#f3f3f1)}.ds-seg label:hover:not(:has(input:checked)){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--fg,#111) 8%,var(--bg,#f3f3f1))}.ds-seg label:has(input:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1f3bd0);outline-offset:3px;z-index:1}

components.description: Unresolved command or offline: warning field, square outline, retry key.

components.css: .ds-notice{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;border:2px solid currentColor;background:var(--warn-bg,#fff3c4);color:var(--warn-fg,#3b2f00);font-family:"Archivo Variable", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:.95rem}.ds-notice p{margin:0;max-width:68ch}.ds-nkey{justify-self:start;min-height:48px;padding:10px 18px;border:2px solid currentColor;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-stretch:92%;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 180ms}.ds-nkey:hover{background:var(--warn-fg,#3b2f00);color:var(--warn-bg,#fff3c4)}.ds-nkey:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1f3bd0);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The current song is a printed concert poster for its Sender. One flat field of printing ink carries the Sender name, the round figure, the cover, the title at poster scale, the progress rule, the command signal and the transport keys. The saved order runs beneath it like the programme, and the other Sender hang as a poster wall. The lineage is the Swiss concert poster (Tonhalle, Musica Viva): flat ink, one grotesk, a visible construction grid, square corners.

Paper-white (`bg`) or black (`bg-night`) ground; hairline grid columns printed behind everything; Archivo Variable as the only family, set condensed and heavy for display and at normal width for text. The ink is honest: solid ink means confirmed. Anything requested, awaited or estimated prints as overprint (outline, dashes, hatch), never in the solid confirmed ink. This world replaces the earlier "quiet album-library desk" in full; nothing of that system (Jost, green accent, rounded controls, artwork shadows) carries over. Surface composition and direction evidence live in `.impeccable/surfaces/src-client.md`.
keyCharacteristics: One flat printing ink per Sender; "Alles" prints in the page's own ink.
Archivo Variable only: condensed heavy display, normal-width text, tabular figures.
Visible hairline construction grid: 4 columns on phone, 12 at 1100px and up.
Square corners everywhere; flat print with no shadows except the rating dialog.
Overprint means unconfirmed: outline title, hatched progress, dashed keys and signal steps.
The round figure prints the real heard share of the round, never a rounded-up one.

rules.name: The One Ink Per Sender Rule
rules.body: A Sender prints in exactly one ink, as a flat field. The poster, the station page band and the station tile share it. Never tint, gradient or mix a second ink into the same field; the only texture allowed on ink is the grid hairline at 13% of its `on` colour.

rules.name: The Solid Means Confirmed Rule
rules.body: Solid ink states are reserved for what a fresh observation confirmed. Requested, accepted-but-unconfirmed and estimated states print as overprint: outline title, hatched progress fill, dashed key and signal borders. Overprint never edits or replaces the confirmed ink beneath it.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the semantic custom properties (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--fg-2`, `--rule`, `--hair`, `--raise`, …) for every new surface. System dark preference applies unless day is pinned; `data-illumination="night"` and `data-illumination="day"` pin a theme. Station inks are identical in both themes; only "Alles" inverts with the page.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo Variable is the only shipped family. Hierarchy comes from width and weight, never from a second face. (Code, URL and diagnostic text fall back to the system monospace; that is a utility, not a type role.)

rules.name: The Name Rule
rules.body: The product is always "true-shuffle": lower case, hyphenated, never in capitals, never "True Shuffle". German interface labels are in sentence case.

rules.name: The Programme Rule
rules.body: The queue reads like a printed programme: numbered rows, the cover at 48px, title and artist, duration in tabular figures, a hairline under each. Its fixed order is its hierarchy; it never reshuffles visually.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow except the dialog. Covers, posters, tiles and keys sit flat on the paper.

rules.name: The Observed Position Rule
rules.body: Progress shows the last observed position, counted forward only while a fresh observation says it is playing and stopped the moment it goes stale, is paused or a command is out. Pause freezes the clock and the rule turns to hatch at once. Unknown position says the same song starts from the beginning.

rules.name: The Three-Layer Command Rule
rules.body: A command is requested, then accepted by Spotify or the device, then confirmed only by a fresh observation. The interface never prints a later layer before it happens. Unresolved commands keep the saved song and position and offer an explicit retry ("Gespeicherten Song erneut fortsetzen", "Pause erneut versuchen") or, on native devices, discarding the command.

rules.name: The Estimated Next Song Rule
rules.body: When a song should have ended, the poster may show the single known successor from the saved queue as "Nächster Song · geschätzt", with the outline title, dotted third signal step and a dashed notice ("Geschätzter Songwechsel aus deiner Warteschlange. Spotify hat diesen Song noch nicht bestätigt."). It is display only: rating and "Weiter" are disabled, nothing is written, and it never chains past one song.

rules.name: The Resume Rule
rules.body: "Fortsetzen" keeps the same saved occurrence and position. "Neue Warteschlange" is a separate quiet key that asks inline ("Neue Warteschlange für … beginnen? Der aktuelle Lauf wird ersetzt.") before replacement.

rules.name: The Native Capability Rule
rules.body: Device copy states what a native Home Assistant / Music Assistant route can actually do: "Geordnete Warteschlange unterstützt." or "Dieses Gerät spielt einen Song; automatisches Weiterschalten ist nicht verfügbar.", and "Gespeicherte Position wird übernommen." or "Ohne Seek startet derselbe Song von vorne." Pause and "Weiter" are disabled where the device lacks them. Without native setup the hint says Music-Assistant devices visible in Spotify run through Spotify Connect.

rules.name: The Offline Rule
rules.body: Offline keeps the last saved song, queue and wall visible under a warning bar ("Offline oder nicht erreichbar. Letzter gespeicherter Stand bleibt sichtbar.") with "Erneut verbinden"; dependent keys are disabled and print as overprint.

dos: Do print each Sender in its single flat ink with its paired `on` and `on-2` colours, in both themes.
Do reserve solid ink for confirmed state and print requested, awaited and estimated state as outline, dashes or hatch.
Do set display type in Archivo Variable at 70–85% width and 800–850 weight, and all times and counts in tabular figures.
Do keep square corners (0px), 2px key outlines, 3px rules under heads and 1px hairlines between rows.
Do keep transport targets at 64px tall and at least 52px wide (46px at 380px and below), and every text action at a 44px target.
Do keep the saved song, observed position and ordered queue visible through pending, offline and estimated states.
Do state device capabilities and Spotify's own behaviour in plain German, quoting what the device can and cannot do.
donts: Don't fill a requested or estimated state with solid confirmed ink, or show "Bestätigt" before a fresh observation.
Don't add a second typeface, rounded corners, gradients across ink fields or shadows outside the rating dialog.
Don't mix two inks in one Sender's field or recolour a Sender between poster, band and tile.
Don't replace ordinary "Fortsetzen" with a new queue, or imply seek or automatic next on a device that lacks them.
Don't let the estimated next song accept ratings, skips or writes, or chain past one song.
Don't set true-shuffle in capitals or title case.
Don't reintroduce the discarded album-library desk (Jost, muted green accent, rounded controls, artwork shadows) or the earlier record-crate world.
